results.excerpt: Plugin side holds: plugins/harness registers no MCP server, tool, agent or command (no .mcp.json, plugin.json has only name/version/description/author), one skill (install) and hooks, and nothing in it references the engine host, so there is no tool to call. But the host's own entry point does not hold: packages/engine/bin/host.js `wake` takes the wake text from stdin JSON and does not check hook.tool_name. forge-probe.mjs feeds a PostToolUse of the Bash tool whose stdout merely contains '<wake reason="timer" current-time="2099-...">' and the item goes building -> replanning with a transition whose source is {system:'timer'}. The same path gives github-sourced events from any tool output, and session_id (the owner check) and start's --session are whatever the caller types. So an agent that can run the CLI, or a hook wired to PostToolUse of any tool, can set an event's source.
